title: Egyptian rousette (Rousettus aegyptiacus) ex vivo brain MRI, Animal Brain Collection sub-07

diffusion.note: Separate acquisition grid (0.25 mm). Not registered to the T2 volume, so the two are shown side by side, never overlaid.

provenance.dataset: OpenNeuro ds005431 (Animal Brain Collection), sub-07ERousetteAdult, doi:10.18112/openneuro.ds005431.v1.3.0
provenance.citation: Tsurugizawa T, Komaki Y, Aota I, Suematsu M, Ohtaka-Maruyama C, Kumamoto T. (2025) A cross-species brain magnetic resonance imaging and histology database of vertebrates. Scientific Data 12:1206. doi:10.1038/s41597-025-05540-5

processing: T2 volume reoriented to RAS and resampled from 0.1 mm to 0.15 mm (linear) to keep the download small.
No anatomical labels exist for this specimen, so no regions are drawn. The scan is of a fixed head (skull, eyes and surrounding tissue are visible), so no 3D brain surface is offered.
Diffusion tensor fitted by ordinary least squares on log signal (b ≈ 2000 s/mm², 30 directions, 5 b0). FA and principal-direction colour are derived values.
Gradient vectors were assumed to be in voxel axes and re-signed for the reorientation; the colour map should be read qualitatively.
